title: Holomorphic Obstructions and Surrogate-Debiased Finite-Sample Spectral Certificates for Machine-Learned Quantum Monte Carlo
abstract: Recent hybrid quantum-classical quantum Monte Carlo (QC-QMC) workflows accelerate classical postprocessing of randomized quantum measurements by compressing matchgate-shadow overlaps into differentiable machine-learning surrogates satisfying Slater-determinant equivariance f(Phi U) = det(U) f(Phi). We resolve two mathematical hazards introduced by such surrogates: non-physical bias and uncertified statistical error. First, we prove an elementary Grassmannian characterization (Theorem 2.1): for 1 <= eta < N, a C^1 GL(eta, C)-equivariant surrogate represents a physical fermionic trial state if and only if dbar f = 0, equivalently if and only if the anti-holomorphic Green's defect G^{dbar} vanishes identically, equivalently if and only if f annihilates all finite linear Slater-determinant syzygies. Left-projector affine backflow G0 + P_Phi A collapses to a fixed Slater determinant, whereas general affine-trace or nonlinear backflow neural quantum surrogates leave the physical Hilbert space, obey a sharp distance floor eta_Pl(f; S) = ||(I - S S^+) f_S^*||_2, and incur representation-dependent mixed-estimator bias even on zero-walker-error decompositions of the exact ground state (including unphysical energies strictly below E0). Second, we prove a sharp Mixed-Energy Variational-Boost Law and generalize it to Surrogate-Anchored Block Hausdorff Certificates for both ground-state upper bounds and oracle-free two-edge visible spectral-gap exclusion using only classical moments a_k and distribution-free Median-of-Means confidence boxes on linear shadow cross-moments Re(b_k) (with exact 3-design variance bound <= 4 a_{2k} for arbitrary complex states), paired with Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) walker debiasing. Core algebraic, complex-projection, variational-boost, and complex spectral-measure conic-dual soundness theorems (16 symbols) are formally verified in Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, zero external dependencies), and all 4-site Hubbard dual certificates are verified in exact rational arithmetic (Q) via symmetry-checked pivoted LDL^T factorization over explicit rational moment enclosures.
